newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street looks set to open higher.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street looks set to open higher.

text.p: Wall Street shares was expected to open higher on Wednesday, taking momentum from yesterday's powerful rise and from end-of-quarter portfolio adjustments by money managers, analysts said.

Investors will be watching for May durable goods orders and existing home sales data, due today, but analysts said the figures would have to be much stronger than expected to dampen market enthusiasm.
"The rally looks set to resume," said Peter Cardillo, director of research at Westfalia Investments.
The Dow Jones Industrial Average rebounded on Tuesday, erasing nearly all of Monday's steep losses to finish up 153.80 points at 7758.06.
